The site is Kestrel Workspace — Sprint 24 Firmware Issue Tracker & Inspector, a saas-workspace-board web application for Kestrel Sprint 24 firmware issue tracker and quick-create workbench.

Owner brief: "Our embedded systems team uses Kestrel to track Sprint 24 firmware and telemetry issues across Triage, In Progress, In Review, and Shipped columns alongside a detail inspector. Build the workspace and quick-create issue flow so engineers can file a bug with title, assignee, priority, subsystem, and reproduction steps, persist it on the server, and inspect it after reloading."

Locale & copy conventions (en-US): Use $ prices, US English spelling and month-day dates. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-33/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Kestrel Workspace — Sprint 24 Firmware Issue Tracker & Inspector: the page for Kestrel Sprint 24 firmware issue tracker and quick-create workbench, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #f8f7f4 (ks-bg), #ffffff (ks-surface), #f1efe9 (ks-rail), #e4e2dd (ks-border), #059669 (ks-emerald), #d97706 (ks-amber), #18181b (ks-text), #52525b (ks-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 10px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--ks-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: an issue status badge that cannot be read or changed by keyboard; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Kestrel Workspace — Sprint 24 Firmware Issue Tracker & Inspector as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Issue title", "Assignee", "Priority", "Subsystem", "Reproduction steps").

User journey context: Review active Sprint 24 firmware and telemetry issues across the Kestrel workspace board and inspector. Open the quick-create issue form and enter an issue title, assignee, priority, subsystem, and reproduction steps. Submit the new engineering issue and reload the issue detail page to confirm it is persisted on the server.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
